skill_name: Write an article comparing the benefits of living in a big city and small town.
workflow: Living in a big city can come with a lot of benefits, such as access to better job opportunities, a varied and vibrant culture, plenty of entertainment and leisure activities, public transportation, and excellent eating options. On the other hand, living in a small town can provide one with a quieter, more peaceful lifestyle, along with a sense of community and togetherness, lower cost of living, and closer proximity to nature and outdoor activities.
